_what_this_is: Coins the Hilal Markets Methodology treats as meme coins. A meme coin is never covered by this standard: it is marked not suitable, under approved condition WG-01. Read by services/meme_coins.py. A coin is also treated as a meme coin, without being listed here, when CoinMarketCap tags it as one or when the project calls itself one on its own pages.
_how_to_add: Add a row with the symbol, the name, the date you decided, one plain sentence saying why, and a page a reader can open that shows it. Then run the tests: a coin listed here may not be admitted in hilal_methodology_admissions.json.
